messages.author: Kodituwakku,Dimuthu Nirmani
messages.body:
Hi,
I'm using secstruct on cpptraj to analyze the secondary structure of my trajectory. It produces an error "Error: Too many bridges for 248 (to 54)". I'm using cpptraj on Amber/20 and charmm forcefields. The command I used for my calculation is "secstruct :1-587 out dssp.gnu nameh HN ".
Any help would be greatly appreciated!
Thank you,
-Dimuthu

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
I’ve made some improvements to the dssp/secstruct code since the AT20
release. Try using the GitHub version of cpptraj; see if that works better.
https://github.com/Amber-MD/cpptraj
-Dan
